mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend over the past 3 months compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has risen by >0.3pp over 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates severe labor market contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises simultaneously, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1700 thousand units combined with slowing GDP growth (GDPC1) below 2.0% annualized signals imminent economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1700 and GDPC1 growth < 2.0% annualized in a late-cycle expansion regime, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point increase in year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) over the past 3 months signals accelerating inflation, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL has risen by >0.5pp over 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 660,000 million dollars combined with rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS < 660,000 and UNRATE rises simultaneously in a late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months indicates strengthening housing demand and broader economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST has risen over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
